title: ront Mount Intercooler Kit (31" x 13" x 3", 3" Core, 2.5" Aluminum Piping Kit)
description: Designed for higher-output street and track builds supporting up to 500–600 horsepower, this heavy-duty intercooler and piping combination maximizes heat rejection and airflow density. The large 24x12x3-inch tube-and-fin core drastically lowers charge-air temperatures, maintaining under 0.5 PSI of pressure drop under typical 15–20 PSI boost levels. Featuring 3-inch end tank connections paired with a complete 2.5-inch 6061 aluminum piping set (1.8mm wall thickness), this kit provides the mandate bends—including 90°, 135°, and U-bends—needed to route piping around radiator supports and frame rails. It comes complete with reinforced silicone couplers and heavy-duty T-bolt clamps to prevent boost leaks under high load. (Note: Because the intercooler ports are 3-inch and the piping is 2.5-inch, 3" to 2.5" silicone reducer couplers are required for final installation).
